ui_bugs.issue: POST /api/auth/login response does NOT include user.features.question_bank. Only /api/auth/me computes it. AuthContext.login() sets user directly from the login response, so immediately after logging in as nitin@nexuacademy.com, TeacherLayout's `user?.features?.question_bank` is undefined and the 'Question Bank' sidebar nav is NOT visible. It only appears after a page reload (which triggers checkAuth() → /auth/me). Regular teachers are unaffected (they should get false either way). Fix: either add features={question_bank: teacher_has_question_bank(user_dict)} to the /auth/login response payload, OR make AuthContext.login() call /auth/me after successful login to hydrate features.

critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py POST /login handcrafts the user dict on line 61-68 with NO features field — this is the root cause of the sidebar-hidden bug. Best fix: refactor to a shared _build_user_response(user, profile) helper used by both /login and /me so features is always populated.

question_bank_routes.py _ensure_bucket() swallows all exceptions except 'already'/'duplicate' — good for idempotency, but any real bucket-create failure (network, quota) will only show up when the subsequent upload() call fails with a less clear message.

question_bank_routes.py record_assignments loops N*M inserts in Python — fine for typical test size (<200 questions × 3 batches), but consider bulk INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with unnest() for performance.

question_bank_routes.py available_for_batches uses ANY($1::uuid[]) — if topic_ids/subtopic_ids ever contain invalid UUID strings, asyncpg will raise. Consider validating with Pydantic Query models or catching and 400ing.

All other backend endpoints and frontend UI flows (topic/subtopic inline-create, question save, tree, search, bank picker, per-batch exclusion, test creation with assignment persistence) work correctly. When retesting after the login-features fix, only need to verify /api/auth/login response now contains user.features.question_bank AND that Nitin sees the nav immediately after login without reload.
rca of the issue: AuthContext.login() (frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js line 63-69) sets user directly from POST /api/auth/login response. Backend /api/auth/login (backend/routes/auth_routes.py line 55-69) constructs the user dict manually with only {user_id, email, name, role, batch_id, profile_pic} — it does NOT invoke teacher_has_question_bank() and does NOT set the `features` key. Meanwhile /api/auth/me (line 120-136) adds `user['features'] = {'question_bank': teacher_has_question_bank(user)}` before returning. Consequence: on first render after login, user.features is undefined → `user?.features?.question_bank` is falsy → TeacherLayout's conditional nav entry is filtered out. A subsequent page refresh triggers AuthContext.checkAuth() → /auth/me → features hydrated → nav appears. FIX: Either (a) mirror the features computation into the /login response, or (b) after setTokens/setUser in AuthContext.login(), call checkAuth() to hit /me and hydrate. Option (a) is preferred (single source of truth for user shape).
